commits.subject: DISABLE check-pick-entered cron: profile endpoint shows settled-only
commits.body:
Eric caught it the same night: he HAD entered the 06-12 pick, but the
user-profile predictions list contains only hit/not_hit/void rows —
pending entries are invisible there, so the check would false-alarm
daily. Cron line removed (box + setup script); command retained but
marked disabled pending an endpoint that exposes pending predictions.
The noon-ET WARN escalation stands (it reads settled-gap persistence,
which was correct for the 06-11 incident).

commits.subject: feat(cli): check-pick-entered v2 — pending entries via GET api/predictions
commits.body:
v1 (2026-06-12) was disabled the night it shipped: its only source, the
user-profile predictions array, is SETTLED-only, so the pre-pitch check
false-alarmed every day. The app JS bundle revealed Api.Prediction.get ->
GET api/predictions, which exposes the OWN pending same-day row (verified
live tonight: the in-flight pick with result null). v2 detects entry from
the UNION of the profile and pending sources; any fetch failure skips
quietly WITHOUT consuming the once-per-day marker, so a transient error
cannot reproduce the v1 false-alarm class — the next 15-min cron run
retries. Closes the 2026-06-11 missed-entry incident class.

commits.subject: chore(ops): wire capture-static + check-pick-entered v2 into cron; ARCHITECTURE sync
commits.body:
Cron: capture-static every 30 min (public files, no auth, content-deduped);
check-pick-entered */15 10-23 ET (the command self-gates to the pre-pitch
window and exits quietly otherwise). Both ride the existing marker install —
re-run `bash scripts/cron-setup-hetzner.sh install` on the box post-deploy.

ARCHITECTURE: leaderboard-watcher section rewritten (static feeds, deep
board storage + censoring rationale, other-user redaction model, and a
correction: the old "10:00 ET captures morning intentions" claim was wrong —
profiles are settled-only); check-pick-entered bullet updated to v2.
